cells.D:
Use the environment to "naturally cook" a live chicken or hen in the ashlands!  Show the chicken/hen alive in the ashlands and then show either it's drops in the lava or it *poof*-ing in the lava.  
Remove ALL built structures after completing and follow all Comfy rules about building in the Ashlands.
Hint: Screen Recording may be easier than screenshots here.  It's not required, but it might help you show that chicken cooking.
Hint 2: Chickens don't drop anything, so you should REALLY record if…
cells.H: /ranger_badge badge_name: Comfy Fried Chicken image: image:
cells.K: 2 screenshots or recording, 1 of the live chicken/hen in the ashlands, and 1 of the POOF or of its drops in lava

cells.D: Set rabbit traps in the Mistlands using spikes or iron foothold traps or other means, and then wait. Submit a screenshot demonstrating the effectiveness of your trapping skills, and bring a total of 20 hare meat and 50 scale hide to the turn-in chests at Ranger HQ or at your Ranger Cabin.

cells.D: The forest is teeming with life and depleting the natural resources. Help restore balance to the ecosystem by delivering 2 stacks each of the following meat to Ranger HQ or the turn-in chests at your Ranger Cabin: Bear, Boar, Deer, Wolf, and Lox.
cells.H: /ranger badge badge_name:Thin the Herd image:
cells.K: Screenshot of items in turn-in chest

cells.D: Become one with nature, and put your sneak skill to the test as you observe the local wildlife. You'll need to get as close as possible to a wild Bear, Boar, Deer, Hare, Lox, Neck, and Wolf. Take a screenshot crouching next to each animal in its natural habitat before it becomes alerted to your presence.
cells.H: /ranger badge badge_name:Wildlife image: image2: image3: image4: image5: image6: image7:
cells.K: 7 screenshots of you being sneaky, one with each listed animal

cells.D: Venture into the wilderness with your hoe & cultivator and plant 3 seed-carrots in the Black Forest, 3 seed-turnips in the Swamp, and 3 seed-onions in the Plains.  SEED-veggies, not the actual veggies!
cells.H: /ranger badge badge_name:Wildtender image: image2: image3:

cells.D:
Locate a Bear or a Vile in the wild, then construct & decorate a cave-like home in which it can live, meaning the home is to be enclosed above and on 3 sides, with a bear/vile inside.  You may use natural terrain and/or Stone/Black Marble/Grausten to build it.  Include a sign with your name(s) and the date of construction, and submit a screenshot of the animal in its beautiful new home.
Bear puns highly recommended
cells.H: /ranger badge badge_name:Bearly an Inconvenience participants:(Tag all participants) image:
cells.K: Screenshot of a bear or a vile in its decorated cave enclosure

cells.D: Gather your allies and slay the tormented spirits of the Swamp, so that they may find peace and the land can begin to heal. Two or more Rangers may claim this badge by submitting a screenshot of their battle with a Wraith and bringing 5 chains per person to the turn-in chests at HQ or your Ranger Cabin.

cells.K: 2 screenshots, 1 of all participants fighting a Wraith in the Swamp and 1 of 5 chains **per participant** in turn-in chest

Let the player know they can thank you in the Rangers' channel.

cells.B:
Hidden throughout the Comfy wilderness, the God-Firs grow—even as the blight continues to spread. Seek out five of these sacred evergreen trees, each dedicated to a different god. Pay your respects with an offering, if you wish. Their locations are known only to those who look.

Submit screenshots of 5 different God-Firs in #🏹-ranger-submissions with god names clearly visible.
cells.D: /ranger badge badge_name:God-Firs image: image2: image3: image4: image5:

cells.B:
A poison curse has begun to seep through the wilderness, rotting the land and driving many creatures from their homes. Among the displaced are honeybees, whose hives have collapsed under the spreading blight. To protect them, Rangers have established a secret sanctuary in a secluded forest, somewhere north-west of the Deer God's domain...but still east of Spawn :)

Tend the hives at the Lost Bees Refuge and deliver any honey you gather to the donation chest at the Best West Farm. If the chest i…
cells.D: /ranger badge badge_name:Beekeeping image: image2:

cells.B:
The Rangers Guild has adopted a pack of 5 local wolves displaced by the spreading curse. Prospective wardens are tasked to venture in, around, and through HQ to perform regular checks on the protected animals' well-being.
